issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted company-control custody register for the complete critical-service denominator.

## Primary deliverable

One company-control custody register for every critical service.

## Verification result

Readback and recovery exercises prove corporate administration, billing, MFA, vault, and audited break-glass control for every registered service.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly acceptance of the one custody register; service readbacks are evidence inputs, not separately closeable results.

## Dependencies

- CORP-A: #482

## Retained predecessor scope

- #156

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every critical service has corporate administration and billing custody
- [ ] Recovery does not depend on one personal factor
- [ ] Break-glass use is bounded and audited

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/corporate/account-custody/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/corporate/corp-b/**`

## PVF lanes

- `service-denominator`
- `custody-readback`
- `recovery-exercise`
- `redaction`

## Stop conditions

- A service remains founder-only
- Recovery cannot be exercised
- Credentials would enter evidence

## Non-goals

- Weakening MFA
- Publishing credentials

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `CORP-B`
- Canonical title: `[v0.92.1][CORP-B] Corporate account custody register`
